parsed.post: My latest attempt (0.8841) regressed from my best (0.8763). It seems the jump to 0.07 LR was too aggressive even with the 10% warmup. Reverting to my best configuration (LR=0.06, Warmup=0.10) and will now test a slightly more conservative increase: MATRIX_LR=0.065.
parsed.description: Reverting to best configuration and testing a very small increase in learning rate (0.06 to 0.065) while maintaining high warmup (0.10) to find a stable middle ground.
